selectionReason: First ten absent Jōyō rows on the B168 receipt. Supports qualify through JMdict ichi1, news1, spec1 or gai1, with news2 and spec2 also qualifying under issue #60 comment 7112026459; 恭 alone uses a documented untagged route.

selectionNotes.忍: 忍ぶ (news2/ichi1) is the kun example in the standard-use table (PDF p. 123). ニン and しの.ばせる are shown with dictionary words and not offered. 偲ぶ is a separate JMdict entry and is not taught as a spelling of 忍ぶ.
selectionNotes.忠: 忠実 (news1/ichi1) is the first example for チュウ in the standard-use table; 実 has a card. The same spelling also writes まめ, a separate word not taught here.
selectionNotes.恒: 恒例 (news1/ichi1) is a standard-use example for コウ; 例 has a card. KANJIDIC2 つねに is source-only: JMdict has no 恒に.
selectionNotes.恭: No spelling containing 恭 carries a priority tag; see the mapping exceptionReason. 恭しい is the kun example in the standard-use table.
selectionNotes.悦: 満悦 carries news2 and spec2 (with nf37) on both spelling and reading; news2 and spec2 qualify under the owner decision in issue #60 comment 7112026459, applied since B160. It is the only spelling containing 悦 with any priority tag. 悦ぶ, 悦び and 悦ばす are rarely used kanji forms and are shown, not offered.
selectionNotes.悼: 追悼 (news1/ichi1) is a standard-use example for トウ; 追 has a card. 悼む is shown on the card for いたむ.
selectionNotes.惨: 惨め (ichi1/news2) is the standard-use kun example 惨めだ; the mapping reuses the kana-headed article みじめ (entry 1303280, sense 1), as B164 reused おばあさん for 婆. KANJIDIC2 いたむ is source-only: JMdict has no 惨む.
selectionNotes.惰: 怠惰 (news2/ichi1) is a standard-use example for ダ, the only reading in the table; 怠 has a card, whose reading row already named 怠惰 and now links it.
selectionNotes.愁: 郷愁 (news1/ichi1) supports シュウ; 郷 has a card. The standard-use examples for シュウ are 哀愁 (spec1/news2) and 憂愁; 憂 has no card. 哀愁 would also qualify through 哀 and remains an unlinked dictionary word on the 哀 reading row; no claim is made that one route is preferable. 愁える and 愁い are shown with their JMdict spelling status.
selectionNotes.愚: 愚か (news2/ichi1) is the standard-use kun example 愚かだ. グ is shown with 愚問 and 愚痴 and not offered.

supportMappings.exceptionReason: No spelling containing 恭 carries any priority tag in the pinned JMdict (exhaustive scan of every k_ele). 恭しい (entry 1236790) is the kun example in the standard-use table (PDF p. 38); its spelling and its reading うやうやしい carry no irregular, rare, outdated, ateji or gikun mark, and 恭々しい is a search-only form that is not taught. The on-reading examples in the table, 恭賀 (1655220) and 恭順 (1236830), are also untagged, and 賀 has no card. The untagged route of the issue #60 rule therefore applies, with a row-specific justification. Keep this explicit untagged exception for independent review.

supportMappings.priorityTagAttribution: ichi1 and news2 are recorded on both the 惨め spelling and the reading みじめ; the kana-headed article teaches this entry, sense 1.

sources.dictionaryChecks: Author re-read the Digital Daijisen bodies on Weblio for 惨め (みじめ), 忍ぶ (しのぶ), 忠実 (ちゅうじつ), 恒例 (こうれい), 恭しい (うやうやしい), 満悦 (まんえつ), 追悼 (ついとう), 怠惰 (たいだ), 郷愁 (きょうしゅう) and 愚か (おろか); the 実用日本語表現辞典 entries ご満悦 (2023; 「心から喜び、満足している状態を表す言葉」) and 御満悦 (2010; 「満悦」の丁寧な表現, 別表記 ご満悦), and its entry 恭しい (2023; often written in hiragana as うやうやしい, e.g. うやうやしい態度 and うやうやしくお辞儀をする; seldom deliberately used in present-day everyday conversation; sometimes used ironically, with a nuance of affectation such as 「必要以上に丁重っぽく」); the Weblio example 恭しい態度を執る; the Digital Daijisen character entries じつ【実〔實〕】 (sense 4 「まごころ。まこと」, which lists 忠実), れい【例】 (sense 3 「以前から行われている事柄。ならわし。いつもどおり」, which lists 恒例) and つい【追】 (sense 4 「以前のことをあとからたどる」, which lists 追悼); and the official standard-use table rows for all ten kanji (PDF pages 123, 108, 54, 38, 16, 118, 63, 102, 74 and 42). Daijisen examples quoted in the articles are attributed to it; the bulleted example sentences are original.
